column1: # Ocarina of Time (Switch 2, 0400486024DEC000): the amiibo its Game/AmiiboSetting file accepts, for the in-game menu's Amiibo list (GameMenu.swift). id<TAB>name<TAB>group.
# Mask: NumberingID_1277 and _1279, one mask each and no daily limit; these two figures are not in the public amiibo database yet, so only the model number (the game's rule) is real.
# Drops: the Legend of Zelda amiibo series (AmiiboSeriesID09) and Link, Zelda and Ganon of any series, 3-5 random drops. IDs and names from amiiboapi.
